contexts.text: By Jacob is represented the Lord's exterior man, or the Divine Natural. AC 2630. AC 4189. AC 4286:7. AC 4295.
A bullock for sin = the Lord's Divine Natural.
Exploration from the Divine Natural. Signified.
Acknowledgement through the Divine Natural. Signified.
Initiation is effected through the Divine Natural.
Perception from the Divine Natural how the case was. Signified.
The elder servant of Abraham's house who administered all things that belonged to him = the Divine Natural. References.
The conception and birth of the Divine Natural; as to good, which is Esau, and as to truth, which is Jacob. Treated of. AC 3279. AC 3289. AC 3293. AC 3314. AC 3576.
Under Divine Rational, see these references. AC 3279. AC 3705. AC 4211:3. AC 6947.
(Rebekah barren) = the Divine Natural not yet.

The Divine Natural came forth from the Divine good of the Rational as a father, and from the Divine truth there as a mother: when as yet there was no Divine Natural, it is said that rational truth was barren.
The first beginning of the Divine Natural as from a mother. Signified.
(Judah) washed his garments in wine, and his clothes in the blood of grapes: here, garments, and clothes = the Lord's Divine Natural.
Who is this that cometh from Edom? here Edom = the Divine good of the Lord's Divine Natural.
The Nazarites represented the Lord as to the Divine Human, especially as to the Divine Natural. AC 5247:4.
(The priests were not to shave their heads) in order that they might represent the Lord's Divine Natural as to the truth which is from good.
His hairs like clean wool = the Divine Natural as to truth.

Esau = the Lord's Divine Natural as to Divine good when first conceived... Edom = the Divine Natural as to good to which there are adjoined the doctrinal things of truth. AC 3313. AC 3322:2. AC 3322:3.
Isaac sent Jacob = the beginning of the coming forth... of the Lord's Divine Natural.
Jehovah shall be to me for a God = that the Divine Natural was also Jehovah. Explained.
The conjunction of the Divine Natural with the goods of works. Signified.
The presence of the Divine Natural in the good which is now represented by Laban. Signified.
The appropriation of good from the Lord's Divine Natural. Signified, Explained.
The enlightenment of (gentile) good by the Lord's Divine Natural. Signified.
Enlightenment is from the Lord's Divine Natural.
Esau = the Divine Natural as to good; here, as to celestial good, because the Natural was not yet made Divine.
Bethel = the Divine Natural.
God said to him, Thy name is Jacob = the quality of the Lord's external Divine Natural... (For) Israel = the Lord's internal Divine Natural. AC 7091.
And Jacob called the name of that place where God spake with him, Bethel = the Divine Natural and its state... Bethel = the Divine Natural.
To journey from Bethel = what is continuous of the progression of the Divine from the Divine Natural. AC 4585:6.
The sons of Jacob were twelve = the state of all things now in the Divine Natural.

We have spoken of the Lord's Natural, how He made it Divine in Himself... But now the conjunction of the Divine Natural with the Rational is treated of, which conjunction is represented by the coming of Jacob to Isaac. AC 4610:end.
The Divine Natural is conjoined through good to the good of the Rational. Signified.
Isaac died = resuscitation in the Divine Natural. Explained.
And was gathered to his people = that it was now among those things which are of the Divine Natural.
That the Lord's Divine Natural was concordant under Divine rational good. Signified, Explained.
Jacob = the Lord's Divine Natural. References.
Their father loved him more than all his brethren = that it was conjoined with the Divine Natural.
He sent him from the valley of Hebron = from the Divine Natural and Sensuous.
The lower things of the Church are said to be from the Lord's Divine Natural and Sensuous; not that these are lower in the Lord; for in Him and His Divine Human all is infinite.
Under Divine Human, see these references. AC 7091.
His teeth white with milk = that the Divine Natural is nothing but the good of truth. AC 9052:2.

The reason the Lord's Divine Natural is said to be the good of truth, is... that they who are of the external Church cannot raise their thought higher than the Lord's Divine Natural; whereas they who are of the internal Church raise it above the Natural to the internal... Hence it is that the Lord's Divine Natural is called the good of truth, when yet the whole of His Human is the Divine good of the Divine love.
The Nazarites represented the Lord as to the Divine Natural, which is the external Divine Human.
The influx of the power of the Lord's Divine Natural into what is sensuous. Signified.
That the Lord as to the Divine Natural is meant by the God of Israel. Illustrated.
Under Eleazar, see these references. AC 9812.
Men of the Church in the world are in the Divine Natural, which also proceeds from the Lord. (Compare TCR 195.)
In the world He put on the Divine Natural also, in which He is present with men... The glorified Human of the Lord is the Divine Natural. TCR 109.
Under Divine Celestial, see these references. AR 959. TCR 195. Coro 51:end.
Under Divine Spiritual, see this reference.

His feet as pillars of fire = the Lord's Divine Natural as to Divine love, which supports all things... The reason His feet were seen as pillars of fire, is that the Lord's Divine Natural, which in itself is the Divine Human that He took up in the world, supports His Divine from eternity as the body supports the soul...

After He came into the world, these representations vanished; the interior reason of which was, that the Lord in the world put on the Divine Natural also, and from this He enlightens not only the internal spiritual man, but also the external natural... TCR 109:end.
The Lord from eternity... had a Divine Celestial and a Divine Spiritual, but not a Divine Natural before He assumed the Human.
